name: Install Link — vNext (via Discovery Config API)
description: vNext linking path: the on-prem HUB calls discovery-config-api over gRPC (IGrpcLinkingService.CreateInstallationAndLink), which translates the request into a GraphQL mutation (installationCreateAndLink) against the Edge Manager (ADP GraphQL endpoint). Edge Manager then calls Multitenant API over gRPC to create the site/install. Differs from the classic path where On-Prem talks GraphQL to Edge Manager directly.

annotations.text: On-prem vNext agent. gRPC traffic multiplexed through Discovery Gateway, dispatched server-side to discovery-config-api. Uses M2M token.

IGrpcLinkingService.CreateInstallationAndLink. LinkingService builds the ADP GraphQL mutation and sends it to AdpGraphQlEndpoint (ADP_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT + ADP_GRAPHQL_PATH). Owned by Discovery Engineering.
ADP GraphQL endpoint (mutation installationCreateAndLink / installationLink). Not in Kafka topology — communicates via gRPC only with backend services.

nodes.text: vNext pasa por discovery-config-api (gRPC). El classic va directo On-Prem -> Edge Manager (GraphQL). Ver flujo edge-manager-flow.
